subject: [PATCH 5/6] mm/page_alloc: keep the range online while alloc_contig isolates it

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug where a gigantic hugetlb allocation can crash due to a range going offline while being isolated by alloc_contig_pages(). The patch adds a check that the range is online before isolating it, and then looks up the zone only after isolation. This prevents the range from going offline during isolation, which was causing crashes when memory was removed concurrently.
